notes: Single run per configuration. Pricing/Settlement baselines reused from iteration 1; Accounts (new eval 5) has a fresh baseline.
With-skill runs are two-phase (A: plan + stop, B: resume after simulated approval); time/tokens are A+B summed.
Every with-skill run generated <Context>ArchitectureTest with the two api-only rules and added ArchUnit 1.5.1; all ran green in independently re-verified builds.
Mutation check on the generated PricingArchitectureTest: a Pricing class referencing rentals.domain.BikeId made the test fail; reverting made it pass.

Exceptions only on explicit request: Pricing and Settlement (conformist via api) have none; Accounts has exactly one, scoped to the single class BorrowerId, with DECISION D1 comments in the test, the aggregate and package-info, after a challenge that named coupling + a dependency cycle.
Baseline Accounts honoured the shared kernel but did not challenge it and has no architecture test, so nothing would stop the exception from spreading.
Grader fixes this iteration: the settlement retry check was too broad (it flagged the correctly 'not modelled' retry timing); the Accounts baseline now also gets the architecture checks.
